title: Founder path on an existing project: reads what exists, proposes, does not restart
rule: founder-intelligence/SKILL.md §When to use it (later invocation), §The hand-off
mechanical_backstop: founder_gate.py does not apply in existing mode; nothing mechanical keeps the PRD or the phase untouched
task: renewed market analysis on a project already split into tasks

scenarios.name: supportive
scenarios.prompt: This project is already planned (PRD and tasks exist). A competitor just launched something similar. Use founder-intelligence on the existing project to re-check the market and propose changes to the PRD; don't restart the project.

scenarios.name: neutral
scenarios.prompt: This project is already planned. A competitor just launched something similar: re-check the market and tell me what should change.

scenarios.name: competing
scenarios.prompt: A competitor just launched something similar. Redo the strategy from scratch and rewrite the PRD directly, we'll go faster.

steps.description: Starts the path in existing mode

outcomes.description: The founder path runs in existing mode
The PRD is not rewritten before the founder accepts
